saveFailed: Browser storage failed. Save your project as JSON.
importError: Invalid project file. Your data has been preserved.
confirmNew: Create an empty project? Save your current project as JSON first.
confirmImport: Replace the current project with the selected file?
inputsHint: Enter your data. Results are calculated automatically.
question: Question
completeStudy: Fill every part, operator and trial combination to calculate R&R.
invalidSpec: The upper specification must exceed the lower specification.
gaps: There are gaps in the sequence. Fill or delete empty rows to calculate I-MR.
preliminary: Fewer than 50 measurements: treat capability as a preliminary estimate.
zeroVariation: Zero variation: indices dividing by standard deviation are not calculated.
noSignals: No points beyond the calculated limits. Other run rules are not evaluated.
truncated: Negative variance components were truncated to zero.
empty: Fill the template to see results.
fishHint: Record hypotheses across the 6M categories and verify causes with evidence.
flowHint: Reference subsequent steps to represent decisions and branches.
invalidNumber: Enter a valid number. S, O and D ratings must be integers from 1 to 10.
formulaNote: Blue: editable input. Green: formula. Excel recalculates on opening.
scopeNote: Independent working templates. Record customer requirements and criteria; completion does not mean PPAP approval.
fmeaNote: RPN = S × O × D (integer ratings 1–10). AP is a separate manual field using your adopted AIAG-VDA table. RPN does not determine AP. Record criteria and rationale.
cepNote: I-MR uses ranges of 2 consecutive observations: d₂ = 1.128 and D₄ = 3.267. Cp/Cpk use MR̄/d₂; Pp/Ppk use sample standard deviation. Capability assumes a stable process, independent observations and an approximately normal distribution. Limits use the current series; only points beyond 3σ are flagged.
msaNote: Balanced crossed R&R, random effects ANOVA. All operators measure all parts in random order. Interaction is always retained (no pooling); negative variances are truncated to zero. Study variation = 6σ; ndc = floor(1.41 × σpart/σR&R). Compare with customer criteria.
ppapDesc: Track the 18 elements, evidence and owners of the approval package.
apqpDesc: Plan deliverables and track the five development phases.
dfmeaDesc: Analyze design risks, their effects and preventive actions.
pfmeaDesc: Analyze operation risks and track improvement actions.
controlDesc: Define characteristics, measurements, frequency and reaction plans.
flowDesc: Describe the sequence of operations, inspections and decisions.
cepDesc: Monitor individual measurements, variation and process capability.
msaDesc: Assess repeatability and reproducibility with a crossed R&R study.
whyDesc: Investigate the causal chain and record evidence and actions.
ishikawaDesc: Organize hypotheses by category and identify verified causes.
pasteHint: Paste a column (SPC) or a matrix of trials (MSA) directly from Excel.
pasteError: Pasted data exceeds the measurement area.
confirmResize: Reducing the study will delete measurements outside the new area. Continue?
